description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to develop modern cloud-native applications supporting mission-critical intelligence and geospatial platforms. You will design, develop, and maintain user interfaces, APIs, backend services, and cloud-native microservices that enable analysts and mission partners to securely discover, process, and exploit geospatial data.

 This is a hands-on software engineering role working across the full technology stack from responsive web applications to scalable backend services and cloud infrastructure.

 Responsibilities: 

 
 A

 Design and develop modern web applications

 Develop RESTful APIs and backend services 

 Build cloud-native microservices

 Develop responsive user interfaces

 Integrate with geospatial services and enterprise APIs

 Build automated testing pipelines

 Participate in Agile development

 Support CI/CD deployments

 Optimize application performance

 Troubleshoot production systems

 Collaborate with architects, data scientists, and mission stakeholders to gather, document, and refine customer requirements, including data mapping and integration needs

 Assist in implementing integration solutions in collaboration with development team members 

 Facilitate communication between stakeholders to ensure timely and effective requirements execution

 Ensure activities align with established processes, standards, and mission objectives

 Contribute to documentation of processes, procedures, integration patterns, and lessons learned

 
 Key Technologies: 

 
 Familiarity with backend systems and integration concepts (APIs, data mapping, file-based transfers)

 Experience with AWS services (S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, ECS, ECR, EKS, API Gateway, Cloudwatch, KMS)

 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD or similar)

 Understanding of containerized and serverless environments

 Familiarity with data transfer and file processing concepts

 Familiarity with dashboards, metrics, and operational visibility tools

 Understanding of secure data handling and access control concepts (IAM, least privilege)

 
 Frontend 

 
 JavaScript - React, Angular, HTML5, CSS3

 
 DevOps 

 
 Docker, Podman, Kubernetes

 GitLab, Harbor

 CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform, other IaaC

 Linux

 
 Backend 

 
 Auroa, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle (w/spatial)

 KVS – Redis, Memcache, Elasticache

 GDAL/OGR etc.

 Other storage tech (s3, NFS, CIFS, SAMBA, NAS, SAN, DAS, etc)

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 Active TS/SCI clearance (eligible for CI Poly) 

 1-3(Junior), 3–7(Journeyman), 8-11 (Senior), >12 (Principal) years of experience in software development, system integration, or technical support roles

 Experience working directly with customers or stakeholders in a technical or mission environment

 Strong communication and coordination skills across technical and non-technical teams

 Experience gathering and documenting requirements

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment

 Familiarity with Agile development practices

 Experience using GitLab or similar tools for collaboration and tracking

 
 Desired Qualifications: 

 
 Familiarity secure data movement environments

 Experience working with enterprise service processes such as Service+

 Development or scripting experience (Python, JavaScript, or similar)

 Experience with data mapping or integration workflows (using JSON or other object notation)

 Familiarity with operational dashboards and metrics reporting

 Experience supporting customer requirement implementation and/or system integration efforts

 Experience building cloud-native applications

 Experience with microservices

 Experience with geospatial applications

 Experience with mapping frameworks

 Experience with GDAL or geospatial libraries

 Experience supporting Intelligence Community customers

 
  
  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
